text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through the Twinkle Series
with my partner Umamusume would begin.
The name of the girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...I'm not any kind of amazing Umamusume...
Honestly, I don't have much confidence either... but...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...I-I want to become a 'Great Umamusume'!
...So, I look forward to working with you!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle Series
with <chrname> began!
